definition_text: Personal Data means data relating to an identified or identifiable individual, wherein an identifiable individual is a person who can be identified, either independently or in a combination with other information, directly or indirectly, through an electronic or nonelectronic system.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: Personal Data Protection means a comprehensive effort to protect Personal Data in all stages of processing in order to guarantee the constitutional rights of the Personal Data subject.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: Information means any description, statement, idea, or sign containing value, meaning, or message, associated with data, facts, or the description thereof, which is visible, audible, or readable, as conveyed in various packages and formats that keep abreast of the development of electronic or nonelectronic information and communications technology.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: Personal Data Controller means a person, public body, and international organization that acts individually or collectively to define the purposes, and controls the processing of Personal Data.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: Personal Data Processor means a person, public body, and international organization that acts individually or collectively to process Personal Data on behalf of the Personal Data Controller.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: Personal Data Subject means an individual to whom Personal Data is attached.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: Any Person means an individual or a Corporation.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: Corporation means an organized group of persons and/or assets, whether incorporated or unincorporated.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: Public Body means the executive, the legislature, the judiciary, and other bodies whose main functions and duties are related to the administration of the state, and whose funding is partly or wholly sourced from the State Budget and/or the Regional Budget, or non-governmental organizations to the extent the whole or any part of the fund is sourced from the State Budget and/or the Regional Budget, the public and/or foreign donations.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: International Organization means an organization that is recognized as the subject of international law and has the capacity to enter into an international agreement.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: Central Government, hereinafter referred to as the Government, means the President of the Republic of Indonesia with the power of the Government of the State of the Republic of Indonesia vested in him/her under the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: "Principle of protection" means that every act of processing of Personal Data is conducted by giving protection to the Personal Data Subject of his/her Personal Data against misuse.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Principle of legal certainty” means that every act of processing of Personal Data is conducted on a legal basis to actualize Personal Data Protection and anything else in furtherance of the implementation thereof in order to gain legal recognition within and outside court.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Principle of public interest” means that in upholding Personal Data Protection, due regard must be given extensively in the general public or community interest. Public interest includes the interests of state administration and the interests of national defense and security.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: "Principle of benefit" means that the regulation on Personal Data Protection must be beneficial to the national interest, to especially achieve the ideals of public welfare.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Principle of prudence” means that parties involved in the processing and supervision of Personal Data must be concerned about any aspect with potential to cause loss.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: "Principle of balance" means an effort to protect Personal Data in order to balance the right to Personal Data and legitimate state rights in the public interest.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Principle of accountability” means that parties involved in the processing and supervision of Personal Data should act responsibly so as to ensure the balance of rights and obligations of the relevant parties, including the Personal Data Subject.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Principle of confidentiality” means that Personal Data is protected from unauthorized parties and/or from unauthorized processing of Personal Data.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: Special category Personal Data is Personal Data which, if processed, may have a greater impact on the Personal Data Subject, including discriminatory treatment and greater loss to a Personal Data Subject.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Health data and information” means individual records or statement relating to physical health, mental health; and/or health services.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Biometric data” means data relating to physical, physiological, or behavioral characteristics of individuals that allows unique identification of individuals, such as facial images, or dactyloscopic data. Biometric data, which is duly guarded and maintained, also indicates the uniqueness and/or characteristics of a person, including, but not limited to, fingerprint mapping, retina, scans, and DNA samples.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Genetic data” means all data of any kind relating to the inherited or acquired genetic characteristics of an individual in early prenatal development;
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: "Criminal records" means a written record of a person who has committed a tort or broken the law or is currently in the process of justice for the commission, including police records and inclusion on the banned-exit and -entry list.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Personal financial data” includes, but is not limited to data on bank deposits, including savings, fixed deposits, and credit card data.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

term: Personal Data as combined to identify a person
definition_text: “Personal Data as combined to identify a person” includes cellular telephone numbers and IP Address.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Profiling” means an activity to identify a person, including, but not limited to, Personal Data Subject’s work experience, economic conditions, health, personal preferences, interests, reliability, behavior, location, or movements in an electronic fashion.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: "Interests of law enforcement" means interests related to efforts or measures in the scope of implementing or enforcing the rule of law based on the provisions of law and regulations, including the process of preliminary investigation, full investigation, and prosecution.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

term: Public interest in the scope of the administration of the state
definition_text: “Public interest in the scope of the administration of the state” includes demographic administration, social security, taxation, customs, and electronically integrated business licensing services.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Financial services sector” means banking, capital markets, insurance, financing institutions, pension funds, technology-based regulation, financial technology, and other technology under the supervision of Bank Indonesia, the Financial Services Authority, and the Deposit Insurance Corporation.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: "Display" means an act of showing Personal Data for certain purposes and to certain parties.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Publication” means notification of Information which is addressed to many people and is general in nature.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Transfer” means movement, transmission, and/or reproduction of Personal Data electronically or nonelectronically from a Personal Data Controller to another party.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

term: Vital interest of the Personal Data Subject
definition_text: “Vital interest of the Personal Data Subject” means interest related to the survival of the Personal Data Subject when, for example, the processing of the Personal Data is needed for serious medical treatment.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Details of the Information collected” means a list of Information about Personal Data of a Personal Data Subject, both in the form of Personal Data in general categories and Personal Data in special categories, which is collected by the Personal Data Controller to process Personal Data.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

term: Period of processing of Personal Data
definition_text: “Period of processing of Personal Data: means the time span from the start to a completed series of Personal Data processing activities in accordance with the purposes for which the Personal Data is processed.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Language” means the Indonesian Language.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Restricted and specific” means the collection of Personal Data must be restricted according to the purpose for which the Personal Data is processed, and the purpose of processing the Personal Data must be explicit, lawful, and determined at the time of collection of Personal Data.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: "Lawful" means that the Personal Data is processed in compliance with law and regulations.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Transparent” means that the Personal Data is processed by ensuring that the Personal Data Subject is aware of the Personal Data processed and how the Personal Data is processed, and any Information and communications related to the processing of such Personal Data are easily accessible and readily understandable in plain language.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

term: Jeopardizing the safety, physical health, or mental health of the Personal Data Subject and/or other persons
definition_text: “Jeopardizing the safety, physical health, or mental health of the Personal Data Subject and/or other persons” includes alteration of disease history data that has the potential to jeopardize the personal safety and/or other persons.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Disclose another person's Personal Data” includes the meaning that alteration in customer's Personal Data has effect of disclosing another person's Personal Data.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Destroy” means the act of removal, elimination, or destruction of Personal Data to keep it from being reused to identify the Personal Data Subject.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Failure of Personal Data Protection” means failure to protect a person's Personal Data in terms of confidentiality, integrity, and availability, including a security breach, whether intentional or unintentional, leading to destruction, loss, alteration, disclosure, or unauthorized access to Personal Data sent, stored or processed.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: "Certain cases" includes if the failure to protect Personal Data affects public services and/or has a serious impact on the public interest.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Notice” means notice to the Personal Data Subject or notice in general terms through electronic and nonelectronic mass media.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

term: An official or officer that protects Personal Data
definition_text: “An official or officer that protects Personal Data” means an officer or officer responsible for ensuring compliance with the principles of Personal Data Protection and mitigation of the risk of infringement of Personal Data Protection.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

definition_text: “Income” means the gross inflow of economic benefits arising from the entity's normal activities during the period if the inflow results in an increase in equity that does not emanate from investors’ contributions.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

term: Facilitate the settlement of disputes out of court
definition_text: "Facilitate the settlement of disputes out of court" means to provide facilities to settle disputes under the procedures agreed upon by the parties, such as settlement out of court through consultation, arbitration, negotiation, mediation, conciliation, or expert judgment under law and regulations.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf
